name: Eesa Documents
description: Chat-based document management. Connect your own Google Drive; ask the agent to find the right document by meaning, not filename. Files stay in your cloud — Eesa only indexes their content.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Find the most relevant documents by MEANING (semantic search over content), not just filename. Returns titles, matching passages, and links back to the file in the workspace's own cloud.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the documents indexed for this workspace (most recent first).

tools.name: get_document_link
tools.description: Get the shareable link to a specific document by its title or id.

roles.label: Documents Admin
roles.description: Connect the cloud drive, upload, and search all documents. (v1 is admin-only; staff access comes later.)
